details: Dimension bound from Yang's canonical suboplex.
proof: Coordinates outside the effective range are constant on the class and may be deleted.  On the remaining $\mathrm{E}(\mathcal H)$ coordinates, Yang's canonical suboplex is a subcomplex of the boundary of the corresponding cross-polytope; every relevant section has dimension at most $\mathrm{E}(\mathcal H)-1$.  Since Yang dimension is one plus the largest possible homology dimension, $\mathrm{Y}(\mathcal H)\le \mathrm{E}(\mathcal H)$.
name: Effective Range / Yang dimension
